scenario: Item appears to enter a personal bag
preconditions: Qualified shelf view and supported model.
expected_behaviour: Send possible concealment clip for review; product remains unknown unless established.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Ordinary removal of a phone from a bag must be tested; no public alarm.

scenario: Item appears to enter a coat or pocket
preconditions: Visible hands and adequate temporal context.
expected_behaviour: Private review alert with visible action and uncertainty.
negative_or_acceptance_test: A hidden hand alone is insufficient; test coats and accessibility aids.

preconditions: Shelf sweeping class independently qualified.
expected_behaviour: Group related observations and request staff review.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Restocking and collecting multiple purchased products remain benign alternatives.

preconditions: Supplier class available and validated at site.
expected_behaviour: Review event and distinguish legitimate use or packaging damage.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No guessed product identity or price; do not infer theft from eating alone.

preconditions: Exit and till context available.
expected_behaviour: Record unresolved item movement for review.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Paid item, prior purchase and companion payment cases must not be auto-labelled theft.

preconditions: Reliable till view and authorised transaction feed.
expected_behaviour: Link relevant video and transaction exception.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Barcode not visible does not establish a missing scan; no automatic employee allegation.

preconditions: Item identification and transaction context validated.
expected_behaviour: Flag mismatch with sources and confidence.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Similar packaging or wrong product model must yield uncertainty.

preconditions: Documented EPOS permissions and business rules.
expected_behaviour: Queue exception for authorised manager review.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Legitimate returns, authorisation and reversals must be represented.

preconditions: Context shows return to shelf or reviewer establishes it.
expected_behaviour: Correct classification and outcome; retain correction trail.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Earlier alert must not remain a confirmed loss or enrol an identity.

preconditions: Bag use permitted under shop policy.
expected_behaviour: Use context and calibrated class; reviewer may dismiss.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Mere possession or use of a bag is not proof of concealment or intent.

preconditions: Transaction association captures uncertainty.
expected_behaviour: Allow reviewer to attach payment evidence and clear case.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Do not conclude nonpayment from one person not visiting the till.

preconditions: Watermark and source event time available.
expected_behaviour: Mark integration stale; attach later payment without silent revision.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Delayed feed cannot generate a real-time unpaid claim.

preconditions: Scheduled restocking or authorised review context.
expected_behaviour: Dismiss or suppress known work-period candidates where appropriate.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No face-based employee exemption; avoid masking an aisle all day.

scenario: Staff stock removal without recorded movement
preconditions: Authorised restricted-area monitoring and stock feed.
expected_behaviour: Create stock investigation item for limited reviewers.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Personal medicine purchase or legitimate transfer must remain possible.

preconditions: Opening counts and all authorised movement types available.
expected_behaviour: Calculate unit variance and ask for investigation.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Missing delivery, expiry, damage and count error must not become theft labels.

preconditions: Clear continuous video and validated event class.
expected_behaviour: Present event sequence for human context.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No collusion inference from association, friendship or proximity.

scenario: Customer has disability aid or stroller
preconditions: Representative benign tests and qualified views.
expected_behaviour: Apply the same observable-event rules and permit abstention.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Mobility aid, stroller or body movement differences are not standalone triggers.

preconditions: Context available; restricted evidence access.
expected_behaviour: Review cautiously and minimise retained footage.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No child identity enrolment or automatic accusation.

scenario: View is occluded or item is hidden
preconditions: Quality checks and model abstention supported.
expected_behaviour: Show insufficient visibility or coverage gap.
negative_or_acceptance_test: System must not fabricate product identity or a completed action.

preconditions: Temporary visit tracking only.
expected_behaviour: Split or mark association uncertain.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Do not transfer a suspected action to another nearby customer.

preconditions: Aggregate analytics separately justified.
expected_behaviour: Use aggregate exposure analysis or ordinary assistance process.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Dwell time alone must not trigger a crime prediction.

preconditions: Stream and scene-health monitoring.
expected_behaviour: Show affected zone unavailable and notify maintenance.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Frozen image must not be marked live; requalify moved camera.

preconditions: On-duty and alternate routing configured.
expected_behaviour: Private reminder then private escalation with limits.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No automatic siren because a timer expired.

preconditions: Authenticated local device and agreed response plan.
expected_behaviour: Send immediate request to named staff; record routing status.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Notification delivery must not be described as responder arrival.

preconditions: Existing physical panic route remains available.
expected_behaviour: Use commissioned emergency procedure; optional app notice.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No cloud dependency for the established physical panic path.

preconditions: Fresh context and authentication; commissioned output.
expected_behaviour: Send expiring idempotent command and show actual feedback.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Wrong site, expired command, missing confirmation or replay never actuates.

preconditions: Independent commissioned door sensor and arming state.
expected_behaviour: Run the alarm installer approved rule and route.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Cleaning staff and opening schedule tests must pass; no AI-only public activation.

preconditions: Dedicated model and emergency workflow separately validated.
expected_behaviour: Private urgent review or manual panic under site plan.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Never claim life-safety reliability; test safe props only and no automated confrontation.

preconditions: Authorised manager and lawful incident retention.
expected_behaviour: Record human-reported association with evidence and reason.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Previous suspicion does not establish current theft; allow correction.

preconditions: All legal and technical recognition gates satisfied.
expected_behaviour: Private candidate only with independent human review.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Feature disabled in P1; no siren, enrolment or exclusion triggered by a match.

preconditions: Recognition option lawfully enabled.
expected_behaviour: Dismiss, correct record, review threshold and retain limited audit.
negative_or_acceptance_test: A match score cannot establish identity or a new offence.

preconditions: Lawful recognition option with hard expiry.
expected_behaviour: Remove templates and derived references under approved schedule.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Expiry must affect caches and candidate indexes; no unreviewed indefinite retention.

preconditions: Not part of this product.
expected_behaviour: Reject configuration and any cross-tenant identity lookup.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Isolation negative tests must show no cross-client candidates.

preconditions: Health signal and documented offline capability.
expected_behaviour: Show degraded coverage; queue only supported local observations.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No claim of ongoing detection if supplier requires internet.

preconditions: Capture time and arrival time preserved.
expected_behaviour: Mark historical, deduplicate and route for later review.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No expired response command may execute.

preconditions: Capacity telemetry and reserve thresholds.
expected_behaviour: Expire disposable buffers, protect held evidence and flag coverage loss.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No silent loss of held evidence or normal-status display.

preconditions: Clock health and offset estimates available.
expected_behaviour: Flag uncertain ordering and suspend tight sales correlation.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Preserve original timestamps and offset rather than falsifying source time.

preconditions: Stable source ID and idempotency record.
expected_behaviour: One logical observation and at most one actuation.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Same key with different payload must fail with conflict.

preconditions: Manager scope and recorded recipient purpose.
expected_behaviour: Produce controlled package with manifest and audit.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No public permanent link; expired or revoked access fails.

preconditions: Identity verification and privacy workflow.
expected_behaviour: Locate scoped records, protect bystanders and apply lawful decision.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Restore test must reapply deletion before data becomes accessible.

scenario: Unauthorised user or another client requests video
preconditions: Tenant and object-level access controls.
expected_behaviour: Deny without revealing other client metadata.
negative_or_acceptance_test: Direct media URL, API and export tests all fail closed.

scenario: Alarm reports accepted but no physical feedback
preconditions: Commissioned output has no state sensor.
expected_behaviour: Show command sent with unverified physical state.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No false success and no new-ID blind retry.

scenario: Provider app has no supported integration
preconditions: Vendor contract check fails Route B prerequisite.
expected_behaviour: Use Route A with explicit scope or select another supplier.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No scraping private interfaces or promising our alarm controls in a disconnected app.

preconditions: Versioned model and deployment metrics.
expected_behaviour: Disable class or roll back, retain unaffected coverage.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No direct promotion from a live feedback label into production training.

preconditions: Authorised export and documented deletion plan.
expected_behaviour: Detach gateway, revoke keys and confirm deletion timetable.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No live access after termination; backups expire as stated.

scenario: Automatically lock door after suspected theft
preconditions: Excluded actuation type.
expected_behaviour: Reject command at API and gateway.
negative_or_acceptance_test: No deployed permission or adapter for detention or escape control.
